propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the 'rebar' logger process-globally without restoration, silently preventing caplog from capturing rebar.* log records in subsequent tests
caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers fail intermittently with StopIteration or void records when a test that calls configure_logging() runs before them in the test execution order
the poisoning is order-dependent and test-phase-scoped: tests pass in isolation and fail in full runs with different worker orderings, causing false intermittent flakes
removing the propagate=False mutation is safe because uvicorn configures only uvicorn.* loggers with no root handler, so propagated rebar records have no second sink
an autouse fixture or other process-level restoration mechanism is needed to prevent configure_logging() from mutating shared logger state that persists across test boundaries
